shared_or_similar_visual_information: A small square or rotated-square angle marker where two lines meet.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: PB is perpendicular to CQ at R. Right image: BE is perpendicular to AD at E.
Rationales: In both locations the square is attached to the angle between the intersecting lines, so the conventional symbol asserts perpendicularity. Rotation, fill and the surrounding construction do not change the right-angle meaning.
